subject: Re: Kickoff: abbreviation-aware normalization — resourcing
body:
Priya,

Resourcing summary for the half:

Staffing — Nikhil on the survey-to-features pipeline, Paloma on data tooling, Efe on the rule baselines, Umar leading the multilingual model. All four hold through July.

Compute — the rule baselines are CPU-only. For the multilingual normalization model we're doing one big consolidated sweep rather than dribbling runs out: we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation, 256 accelerators, for the week of 2026-07-06, which covers the full training sweep across locale groupings plus the ablations Umar wants (script-family transfer, with/without stump-compound features). Reservation is squared away with the infra process, so the only date risk on the run itself is our own data readiness.

Ask: can you confirm the target locale list by 04-24? The sweep config keys off it.

Bao
